original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克政府批评者遭袭事件未获解决，有罪不罚成政治常态
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克总统丹尼尔·查波访问伊尼扬巴内期间，武装人员据称冒充警察在莫伦贝内带走反对派动员协调员伊尔迪奥·法西特拉·古斯塔沃，其遗体次日于邻近的奥莫伊内被发现。该事件是莫桑比克一系列针对政府批评者及其关联人士的杀害与失踪事件的最新一起。检方在部分案件中已确认并讯问嫌疑人，但整体上相关袭击仍未获解决。

key_facts.fact: 武装人员据称冒充警察在莫伦贝内带走反对派动员协调员古斯塔沃，其遗体次日于奥莫伊内被发现
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: armed men arrived at the home of Ilídio Facitela Gustavo in Morrumbene. According to Anamola, they identified themselves as police officers and took him away in front of his wife and child. His body was found the following day in neighbouring Homoíne.

key_facts.fact: 古斯塔沃是阿纳莫拉在莫伦贝内的政治动员协调员，据报也是警察
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gustavo was Anamola’s political mobilisation coordinator in Morrumbene and is also reported to have been a police officer.

key_facts.fact: 蒙德拉内称古斯塔沃原定在其最高法院审判中作证
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Venâncio Mondlane says he was to be a witness in Mondlane’s forthcoming Supreme Court trial over the protests following the disputed 2024 elections.

key_facts.fact: 2024年10月蒙德拉内律师迪亚斯与代表瓜姆贝在馬普托被枪杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mondlane’s lawyer Elvino Dias and Podemos representative Paulo Guambe were shot dead in Maputo in October 2024.

key_facts.fact: 记者兼反对派活动人士奇萨莱2025年1月被绑架后至今失踪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Journalist and opposition activist Arlindo Chissale was abducted in January 2025 and remains missing.

key_facts.fact: 总检察长称迪亚斯-瓜姆贝案已确认并讯问三名嫌疑人，其中两人被羁押
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In April, Attorney-General Américo Letela told parliament that three suspects had been identified and questioned in the Dias–Guambe investigation, with two held at the Maputo Remand Centre.

uncertainties: 古斯塔沃遇害的凶手及动机尚未确定
绑架者可能只是冒充警察
蒙德拉内尚未证明该谋杀与审判有关
目前仅一个来源（Zitamar News），尚缺乏交叉验证
